openSourceContributions.description: Added boilerplate template with Next.js 15, React 19, Mantine UI v8, and TypeScript for building dashboards and internal tools. Boilerplate for Tanstack Query, i18n, localization, and more.
Added PR and issue template for new issues or PRs.
Managing the repo, assigning tasks, and doing code reviews.
Added AGENTS.md file to provide coding agents with project context. Installed relevant skills to increase AI agent capabilities for the codebase.

Integrated PostHog analytics to track user interactions across the application. Updated Content Security Policy to include PostHog tracking URLs and configured event capturing across multiple components.
Set up Husky and commitlint to enforce conventional commit standards. Added commit-msg hook validation and updated CONTRIBUTING.md with commit guidelines.

highlights: Led frontend for an AI learning platform at 5K+ DAU, owning product cycles end-to-end from design handoff to production in 2–5 days with React, Next.js, and Mantine.
Shipped a streaming AI chatbot and a suite of AI study tools adopted across 5+ products, lifting user session time by 30% and daily engagement by 20%.
Built an OMR + AI evaluation system that cut grading turnaround by 80% and unlocked bulk processing — eliminating manual per-student review.
Built a standalone B2B analytics dashboard as a separate product — Next.js, Ant Design, and GraphQL — surfacing product-usage and business metrics for internal teams.
Shipped 10+ React Native mobile features end-to-end against a Node.js / GraphQL / Hasura backend, owning UI through to the data layer.
Instrumented Mixpanel product analytics that drove data-backed prioritization across 25+ features.
Built a QR-code restaurant ordering system (React, Tailwind) that cut manual staff workload by 50%.
Rebuilt the hotel booking engine on a modular React architecture, cutting new booking-flow shipping time by 25%.
Maintained the open-source Bookingjini Icons Pack, earning 40+ GitHub stars and reviewing 150+ PRs.

infoPanels.title: What kind of roles are you looking for?
infoPanels.content: I am seeking frontend-focused roles where I can work with React, Next.js, and modern UI frameworks. I enjoy building clean, scalable interfaces and would be a strong fit for teams that value quality engineering, thoughtful design, and ownership.

infoPanels.title: How do you approach problem-solving?
infoPanels.content: I break down problems into smaller components, analyze edge cases, and evaluate trade-offs before committing to a solution. I value clarity, maintainability, and predictable outcomes. I also rely heavily on data—profiling tools, performance metrics, and user insights—to guide optimizations.

infoPanels.title: What strengths do you bring to a development team?
infoPanels.content: My strengths include strong UI/UX intuition, deep understanding of React and component architecture, clean code practices, and an ability to communicate clearly with designers, PMs, and backend engineers. I’m proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning end-to-end delivery.

infoPanels.title: How do you ensure code quality and maintainability?
infoPanels.content: I rely on consistent coding standards, reusable components, proper file structures, and strict type-safety when possible. I write clear documentation, perform thorough code reviews, and optimize for readability without compromising performance.
